faqs.q: Sec. 53-72. - Tax requirements for entities outside jurisdiction.
faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person lawfully authorized to deliver medical marijuana
               to do so into or within the city in any form to any person who is lawfully entitled
               to possess or use medical marijuana under the provisions of Article XVIII, § 14 of
               the Colorado Constitution without first having obtained a business license from the
               city pursuant to article III of
chapter 98
of this Code. Any deliveries of medical marijuana into or within the city by any
               person lawfully authorized to make such deliveries shall be subject to the city's
               sales tax pursuant to article III of
chapter 98
of this Code.
(
Ord. No. 4393, § 7(Att. A), 7-1-2013
>;
Ord. No. 4548, § 1, 5-2-2016
)
